evidence.reason: The current code still hard-fails the reuse path when `reviewLogSha256` is unavailable or throws while reading the retained log. Because the reuse record is written only after this validation, the same reusable cycle remains selectable, and the surrounding catch turns the error into `needs-human`, so a deleted/unreadable retained log can block fresh dispatch indefinitely. Reuse is explicitly author evidence, not verification, so inability to validate it should mean “no reuse” and fall through to a fresh dispatch; a digest mismatch may remain a hard stop.
